snapshot.text: Free public care through polyclinics and the Queen Elizabeth Hospital, with a high burden of non-communicable diseases. A new health minister took office in 2026 and declared a 'war' on NCDs.

priorities.title: War on NCDs
priorities.text: The new minister set out a vision for a healthier nation with a focus on NCDs.

priorities.title: More nurse specialisations
priorities.text: Nurse training is expanding into more specialisations.
